text:
Typical delivery decisions and approvals

Platform limitation: The platform is unidentified. This is a generic lifecycle model; only its documentation or configured governance can establish mandatory prerequisites for Start build.

Stage | Typical decision or approval | Typical approver | Usual timing relative to Start build
Discovery | Confirm the problem, expected value, funding, ownership, and success measures. | Business sponsor or product owner | Typically beforehand
Scope and requirements | Agree scope, priorities, constraints, acceptance criteria, and exclusions. | Product owner and key stakeholders | Typically beforehand
Solution design | Choose architecture, data flows, integrations, environments, and nonfunctional targets. | Architect or technical authority | Typically beforehand
Risk and compliance | Review security, privacy, regulatory, accessibility, and data-handling risks. | Security, privacy, compliance, or risk owner | Typically beforehand when applicable
Delivery readiness | Check team capacity, access, dependencies, environments, estimates, and delivery approach. | Delivery lead, engineering lead, and platform owners | Typically beforehand
Build initiation | Confirm that locally required prerequisites are satisfied before invoking Start build. | Authority defined by platform governance | Immediate pre-build check if configured
Build and review | Review implementation choices, source changes, dependencies, and exceptions. | Engineering lead and reviewers | After Start build
Validation | Assess functional, integration, security, performance, and operational evidence. | Test, security, product, and operational owners | After Start build
Release readiness | Approve the release candidate, known risks, rollback plan, and deployment window. | Release or change authority | After Start build
Deployment | Authorize promotion and confirm environment configuration and access. | Environment owner or change authority | After Start build
Operational acceptance | Confirm health, monitoring, support ownership, and incident readiness. | Operations or service owner | After Start build
Post-release review | Assess outcomes, incidents, benefits, and improvement priorities. | Product owner, sponsor, and operations | After Start build
limitations: Exact mandatory approvals, approver roles, and the meaning of Start build depend on the unidentified platform and its governance configuration.
